meta.method: origin of text and labels checked against upstream cards, papers and repositories; tasksource jev_sources.yaml used to map sources to upstreams
meta.policy: permissive only (Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD, CC0, CC-BY, ODC-By, AFL-3.0); no NC/research-only, ShareAlike, copyleft, platform-restricted text, unknown terms
meta.rule: a source is used only if it matches a keep_families prefix and is not listed in exclude

notes:
Source->upstream via tasksource jev_sources.yaml (sources.*.dataset/data_files_from/originals); keep_families keys are plain startswith prefixes, exclude wins; result 107 excluded / 172 kept; copy at scratchpad/licence-audit.json.
Recorded tag contradicted by upstream: x-stance (data CC BY-NC 4.0), monotonicity-entailment+naturallogic (MED CC BY-SA 4.0), amazon_counterfactual (CC BY-SA 4.0), FLUTE (EmpatheticDialogues NC), PromptShield (Alpaca NC/Dolly SA), plus the known stackoverflow/wikihow/amazon_polarity.
Conservative borderline excludes worth a second look: moral_stories (Social-Chem norms verbatim), headline_cause/hlgd (headlines only), cosmos_qa (Spinn3r blogs), discovery (web crawl), cloth, tracie (ROCStories), scone (SNLI-derived).
LLM-generated sets (WANLI, I2D2, agent_action_safety, wildguardmix) kept on creator licence; model-ToS on outputs not treated as a data licence term.
Not directly verified: allenai/wildguardmix card (gated), CLOTH terms page, some DISRPT corpus licences (excluded anyway), GitHub API rate-limited mid-audit.
